SELECT note_id, title, update_time, view_count, is_public FROM note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
AND status = #{query.status} AND status = 1
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND category_id IN #{id}
AND note_id IN ( SELECT note_id FROM note_tag_rel WHERE tag_id IN #{tid} GROUP BY note_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) = #{query.tagIds.size} )
ORDER BY
view_count create_time update_time
ASC DESC

SELECT n.note_id AS noteId, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, u.nickname AS author, u.avatar AS avatar, n.is_public AS isPublic, CASE WHEN IFNULL(cur.attitude, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM note_reaction nr WHERE nr.note_id = n.note_id AND nr.attitude = 1 ) AS likes, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM note_comment nc WHERE nc.note_id = n.note_id AND nc.del_flag = 0 ) AS comments, n.update_time AS updateTime FROM note n INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN note_reaction cur ON cur.note_id = n.note_id AND cur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.note_id = #{noteId} AND n.del_flag = 0 AND n.status = 1 AND (n.is_public = 1 OR n.user_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 1
